title: Ab Ayega Mazaa
overview: Vijay and Nupur start liking each other after a chance meeting at a bus stop.  Suresh (Sidey) is Vijay's boss' son and wants to marry Nupur but ends up liking Nupur's maid, Imarti.  Sidey's father is under the influence of a pot-smoking Swami who has a terrible secret hidden from everyone.
